title: Cron sweeps are inert after the wave deletion: a matching selection refuses because no dispatch shape can name a tick batch
body: A sweep's whole submission design carried the selected ticks as a tick_ids wave under a synthetic bucket epic. l6t deleted that field, and the create-only tracker writer cannot parent the selection under the bucket, so the one orchestrator path would plan nothing. runOneSweep now selects, records and refuses ('Recorded, not spent') rather than booting a guaranteed no-op. Sweeps need a decided shape under the one-orchestrator rule - a re-parent capability in tracker-write, a tick-scoped run, or dropping the feature - and that is a person's decision, not a default this tick should have picked.
